snippet.title: Black Powder Magic - Demo Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Black Powder Magic is a fast-paced 2D action roguelite where precision, timing, and smart decisions decide whether you survive the run — or get consumed by the Infinite.

Play as Kalewar, the Black Powder Mage, and fight your way through a distant planet overrun by escalating threats. Aim your weapons, land skill-shot grenades, time your dashes, unleash powerful ultimates, and build your playstyle with meaningful upgrades.

No autopilot. No passive gameplay.
Every shot, every dash, every mistake — it’s all on you.

The demo is now available on Steam.
Play the demo, challenge the run, and wishlist Black Powder Magic.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3513670/Black_Powder_Magic/
Follow our Teekond Stuudio here on Youtube or on X: https://x.com/teekond_stuudio
